body_markdown:
*The award highlights Genpact's market-leading organic revenue growth as Genpact scales Agentic Operations for global enterprises*


NEW YORK


, Oct. 19, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Genpact (NYSE: G), the Agentic Operations company, has received the Growth Honor of the Year (annual revenue USD 5 billion +) in Everest Group's 2026 Elevate Honors, presented at Everest Group's Elevate conference in Dallas. The honor recognizes the publicly listed global service provider with annual revenue above $5 billion that delivered the strongest year-over-year organic, constant-currency revenue growth over the 16-month period ending June 2026.


The recognition reflects Genpact's accelerating shift to Agentic Operations, as clients increasingly choose Genpact to run and transform finance, supply chain, and other mission-critical operations.


"We are proud to recognize the 2026 Everest Group Elevate Honorees at Elevate in Dallas. These honors reflect Everest Group's independent, fact-based, analyst-driven research and objective assessment of performance and excellence across the provider industry. We congratulate Genpact on being recognized in Growth Honor of the Year (annual revenue USD 5 billion +)," said **Jimit Arora, CEO, Everest Group** .


"Agentic Operations helps enterprises run smarter, faster, and leaner," said **Balkrishan "BK" Kalra, President and CEO of Genpact.** "We put AI agents, proprietary software, process intelligence, and human expertise to work inside enterprise workflows, with responsible AI built in. That's how we help clients grow faster, operate leaner, and convert more to cash. This growth recognition reflects the momentum we're building together and the commitment of our teams around the world."


Everest Group's honor follows Genpact's win in the Best Services Eating Software category of the inaugural 2026 HFS Services-as-Software Awards, which recognized Genpact Agentic Operations, as well as NelsonHall naming Genpact a Leader in all six market segments of its 2026 F&A Transformation NEAT Assessment, including agentic AI and finance transformation.


To learn more about Genpact Agentic Operations, see our


[website](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4800423-1&h=2188971197&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.genpact.com%2Fagentic%2Foperations&a=website) .


**About the Everest Group Elevate Honors** Elevate Honors are a recognition program developed by Everest Group, a leading global research and advisory firm, to select and showcase best-in-class service and technology providers through independent, analyst-driven research. Recognitions are based on Everest Group's fact-based research, proprietary data, and rigorous performance assessments. There are no applications or sponsorships; honorees are selected on performance merit alone.


**About Genpact** Genpact (NYSE: G) is the Agentic Operations company, where applied AI meets context-rich process intelligence. We run and transform mission-critical operations for global enterprises. Genpact's Agentic Operations are grounded in decades of operating core business processes at scale across finance, supply chain, banking, insurance, and more. Our flywheel of advanced technology, trusted data foundations, and deep ecosystem partnerships moves enterprises rapidly from experimentation to scale. AI agents bring speed and precision, human experts bring judgment, and together they deliver outcomes clients can measure.
